test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The celebration of Christmas, Eid, and Holi in school is an example of making children learn fundamental duties as well. Which of the following fundamental duties advocates about this type of ideals?

options.text: To defend the country and render national service
To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To promote harmony and spirit of common brotherhood

solution:
The correct answer is __**To promote harmony and spirit of common brotherhood.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Celebrating festivals **of different religions in school promotes the idea of** unity in diversity,** which is the essence of promoting **harmony and common brotherhood.**
 
• By participating in these celebrations, children learn to respect and appreciate different cultures and religions, which is important for building a **cohesive society.**
 
• This fundamental duty also promotes the idea of** secularism,** which is a key feature of our constitution.
 
• By learning about different festivals, children also learn about the** history and traditions** associated with them, which is a form of cultural education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "To defend the country and render national service," is related to the duty of citizens to protect the **sovereignty, integrity, and security** of the country.

 
 
• This includes serving in the armed forces, volunteering for national service, and being prepared to** defend** the country in times of crisis.
 
 
 
• "To develop the scientific temper," is about the duty of citizens to have a** rational and scientific outlook **towards life.
 
 
• This includes promoting** scientific research**, fostering a** spirit of inquiry,** and rejecting superstitions and blind faith.
 
 
 
• "To safeguard public property and to abjure violence," is about the duty of citizens to** respect public property **and to refrain from using violence as a means of achieving their goals.
 
 
• This includes protecting public property from **damage or destruction,** and resolving conflicts through peaceful means.
